Ask the Agent in natural language to find, organize, compress and restore files, or write reports, summarize documents and answer questions.
· Find, browse and filter files; all information comes from live local queries, never invented
· Write operations (move, copy, rename, trash, compress, extract) are previewed and only run after your confirmation, and can be undone
· Invoke installed tool apps on files, plus general chat and content creation
· Chat is handled by the AI endpoint you configure; the app ships and proxies no API key
· Only file metadata (names, paths, sizes) is sent by default; sending file content requires a separate opt-in
· Deletes go to the recycle bin; sensitive directories are off-limits; all write operations are logged locally
